name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - Après le § 20 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: F a. whereas constitutional changes that weaken the independence of the media or freedom of expression, and erode checks and balances, constitute a direct threat to the values laid down in Article 2 TEU and have a concrete impact on the protection of the EU budget by degrading the environment for transparent oversight of EU funds;
